SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME like '%full%'

select count(1) cnt, 'DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL' tables from d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL
union all
select count(1) cnt, 'DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL' tables from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL




select acid, foracid, file_name from d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL where acid = 'PA302692'
select acid, file_name from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL where acid = 'PA302692'

select distinct file_name from d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL 

select count(1) cnt, file_name from d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL 
group by file_name
order by 2

select count(1) not_exist_in_GAM from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL where acid not in (select acid from d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL )
